items.title_en: Twin sisters born minutes apart discover at 49 that they have different fathers
items.title_zh: 出生相隔几分钟的双胞胎姐妹49岁时发现她们有不同的父亲
items.summary_en: Lavinia and Michelle Osbourne might be biological twins, but quite bizarrely, they don't share the same father. Now 49 years old, the non-identical pair caught up with The Guardian to discuss making this startling discovery five years ago, having been told by their late mother that she'd had them with a wantaway man named James. "[James] was my mum's boyfriend, I suppose," said Lavinia. "From what I was told, when my mum got pregnant , he wasn't happy." Michelle, who was welcomed into the world just minutes apart…
items.summary_zh: 拉维尼娅和米歇尔·奥斯本可能是亲生双胞胎，但奇怪的是，他们不是同一个父亲。五年前，这对不同的夫妇现年 49 岁，他们与《卫报》讨论了这一惊人的发现，他们已故的母亲告诉他们，她和一个名叫詹姆斯的逃亡男子在一起。 “我想，[詹姆斯]是我妈妈的男朋友，”拉维尼娅说。 “据我所知，当我妈妈怀孕时，他并不高兴。”米歇尔，谁是欢迎

items.title_en: Man who bought abandoned ghost town describes incident that 'buried dozens of workers alive'
items.title_zh: 购买废弃鬼城的男子描述了“活埋数十名工人”的事件
items.summary_en: Content creator Brent Underwood has revealed what happens when you buy a California ghost town and 'bring it back to life'. Underwood, who goes by Ghost Town Living on YouTube , spent his life savings to become owner of Cerro Gordo, a former mining settlement established in 1865 which became one of California's most prosperous silver-mining towns. At its peak, Cerro Gordo was reportedly home to more than 4,500 miners, with almost $500 million worth of minerals eventually pulled from the surrounding hills. But life…
items.summary_zh: 内容创作者布伦特·安德伍德透露了当你购买加州鬼城并“让它复活”时会发生什么。安德伍德在 YouTube 上被称为“鬼城生活”，他用毕生积蓄成为了塞罗戈多 (Cerro Gordo) 的所有者，这里曾是一个建于 1865 年的采矿定居点，后来成为加州最繁荣的银矿城镇之一。据报道，在鼎盛时期，Cerro Gordo 拥有 4,500 多名矿工，最终开采出价值近 5 亿美元的矿产
